name: labs/manasp21__oscilloscope_mcp
title: Oscilloscope MCP Ethernet backend (oscilloscope_mcp.EthernetOscilloscope)
intro: Oscilloscope MCP Ethernet backend (oscilloscope_mcp.EthernetOscilloscope), adapted from manasp21/oscilloscope_mcp. It reads `initialized`, `acquisition_active`, `channel_count`, `trigger_source` and 4 more; sets `sample_rate_hz`, `record_length`, `voltage_range_v`, `coupling` and 1 more; runs `configure_channel`, `setup_trigger`, `acquire_waveform` and `stop_acquisition`. `configure_channel`: configure one channel's voltage range, coupling and impedance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
